description: Test suite for store operations related to blocks in the focalboard project, including insert, patch, delete, undelete, and history retrieval functions.

methods.name: StoreTestBlocksStore
methods.description: Runs a series of subtests for store operations related to blocks, including insert, patch, delete, undelete, and history retrieval.

methods.name: testInsertBlock
methods.description: Tests inserting a block with various validation scenarios and updates.

methods.name: testInsertBlocks
methods.description: Tests batch insertion of blocks, including handling invalid blocks.

methods.name: testPatchBlock
methods.description: Tests updating a block's fields, title, and handling errors.

methods.name: testPatchBlocks
methods.description: Tests batch patching of multiple blocks.

methods.name: testGetSubTree2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subtree blocks from a parent ID.

methods.name: testDeleteBlock
methods.description: Tests deleting blocks by ID, including multiple deletions and non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testUndeleteBlock
methods.description: Tests undeleting blocks by ID, including multiple undeletions and non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testGetBlocks
methods.description: Tests retrieval of blocks by various filters and IDs.

methods.name: testGetBlock
methods.description: Tests fetching individual blocks, including non-existent blocks.

methods.name: testDuplicateBlock
methods.description: Tests duplicating blocks as templates or normal, handling non-existent blocks or boards.

methods.name: testGetBlockMetadata
methods.description: Tests retrieval of block metadata and history, including ordering and filtering.

methods.name: testUndeleteBlockChildren
methods.description: Tests restoring deleted blocks and boards along with their children.

methods.name: testGetBlockHistoryNewestChildren
methods.description: Tests fetching the newest children blocks of a card with pagination and filtering.
